title: tiresias.enterprise.decision/v2
description: Pre-call decision contract between a caller (nhe-relay, T2.11) and Tiresias-ZT POST /cp/enterprise/decision (T1.05). Supersedes v1, which authenticated with the platform admin key. Transport: HTTPS POST, header `Authorization: Bearer <relay credential>`, JSON body = #/$defs/request. The relay credential (#/$defs/relay_credential) is issued by a Tiresias admin through POST /admin/relay-credentials, is bound to ONE tenant (the agent leaf's `customer`) and optionally ONE site, is accepted by this endpoint and by no other, is stored by Tiresias only as a SHA-256, and is individually revocable and rotatable. The endpoint REFUSES the platform admin key: any request carrying X-Admin-Key is answered 403 admin_key_refused, and a caller MUST NOT hold or send it. An agent outside the credential's tenant is answered exactly as an unknown agent (404). A credential bound to a site must send that site as `site`. A v1 request (contract v1, or no contract) is answered 410 v1_retired unless the operator has opened a time-limited compatibility window. A 200 body is #/$defs/response; every other status carries #/$defs/error. Caller rules (normative): proceed ONLY on HTTP 200 with decision == "allow"; on decision == "supervised" route the call to the approval channel and do not proceed until a verified approval returns; refuse on decision == "deny", on any other decision value, on any non-200 status, on a body that does not validate, on a contract value other than this one, and on any transport failure or timeout. Absence of a Tiresias configuration, or of a relay credential, is a refusal, never an allow.

identifier.description: A plain identifier: no '/', no '*', at most 128 characters.

agent.description: Registry agent slug (the leaf that owns backend, secret and route policy).

acting_as.description: The acting identity (the capability token's agent_id; for Manto, the employee's agent). Omitted means the agent-wide row.

arguments.description: Tool arguments, matched by canonical JSON (typed) against the template's tool_grants.

site.description: The caller's site. Required, and must match, when the credential is bound to a site; otherwise optional and echoed.

decision.description: The one field a caller acts on. Most restrictive of route policy, tool rules and autonomy.

tenant.description: The tenant the credential is bound to (every answer is about an agent of this tenant).

credential_id.description: The public id of the credential that asked.

contract.description: v2, or v1 for an answer given inside the v1 compatibility window.

relay_credential.description: The raw relay credential: `tzr_` + 16 hex id + `_` + 64 hex secret. The id is public (it names the record for revoke and rotate); the whole value is a secret. A caller holds exactly one, as a deployment secret, and refuses to send any value of another shape.
